title: Generated frontend governance and dispatch evidence

phases.objective: Prove that generated frontend governance and dispatch evidence is reproducible from the reviewed source authority and is current for the exact pull-request head.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Frontend governance and dispatch generators on the exact candidate head
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Both generated JSON artifacts match their source authority and pass deterministic verification without manual editing.
steps: Generate frontend operation governance evidence from the canonical runtime and test manifest sources.
Generate frontend surface dispatch evidence from the governance artifact and canonical route authorities.
After synchronizing the latest main, regenerate both artifacts from the reconciled source tree rather than carrying either parent artifact forward.
Verify source digests, required operations, and deterministic output on the exact candidate head.
assertions: The generated artifacts include both the latest main route authority and the pull-request test-manifest authority.
The generated artifacts are not accepted as hand-edited runtime authority.
Verification runs without repository mutation or Job-log reconstruction.

phases.objective: Publish exact-head generated-artifact drift summaries for every governed writer workflow.
Exercise stale digest, partial generation, and source-authority mismatch failures.
Observe generated evidence consistency on representative pull requests.
Require deterministic generated evidence before protected-branch merge readiness.
